# Warden

> Security-first, AI-led SDLC platform by Techanv Consulting. Warden is the agent OS for secure AI development — it bakes security into every phase as a blocking constraint, not a post-hoc checklist.

## What it is

- 12 blocking security rules enforced before code ships
- 7-tool CI pipeline (gitleaks, semgrep, grype, checkov, and more)
- Human-in-the-loop gates: deployment is blocked until a human reviews flagged risks
- Works with AI coding agents — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Amazon Q
